channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Stock market cheers India-US trade deal, Sensex rallies over 2,400 points
item.description: The Indian equity markets surged sharply by around 3 per cent early on Tuesday with broad-based buying across sectors, buoyed by the announcement of the India-US trade deal.

item.title: Three killed as Himachal bus plunges into ditch in Dehradun
item.description: At least three people were killed and several others sustained injuries after a Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) bus carrying over 30 passengers plunged into a deep ditch in Dehradun’s Vikasnagar area on Tuesday morning, officials said.

item.title: Rajinikanth honors honest sanitation worker Padma with gold chain
item.description: Superstar Rajinikanth on Tuesday met sanitation worker Padma at his residence and honoured the honest worker with a gold chain for her selfless service and good samaritan nature.

item.title: DMK to launch seat-sharing, alliance negotiations as TN polls approach
item.description: The DMK is likely to formally begin alliance and seat-sharing discussions from Wednesday as political activities intensified in Tamil Nadu ahead of the Assembly elections.

item.title: ‘This is our victory’: BJP leaders hail India-US trade deal, credit PM Modi’s leadership
item.description: Senior BJP leaders on Tuesday welcomed the trade agreement with the US, describing it as a historic achievement that reflects India’s growing global stature under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership.

item.title: Indian rupee trades over 1 pc higher after US trade deal
item.description: The Indian rupee surged over 1 per cent on Tuesday, trading at 90.29 to the US dollar, following an India-US trade agreement that sparked investor optimism and prompted foreign inflows.

item.title: Two notorious thieves arrested in alloy wheel theft cases in Delhi
item.description: The Southwest District Police have arrested two thieves involved in multiple incidents of alloy wheel theft, following a meticulous investigation aided by CCTV footage and technical surveillance.

item.title: ‘I just ran out of time,’ says Cummins on missing T20 World Cup
item.description: Australia’s fast-bowling spearhead Pat Cummins has revealed that he came very close to being part of the T20 World Cup 2026 squad, but a minor delay in his recovery ruled him out of the final 15-team squad.

item.title: Karnataka Congress crisis: Deputy CM Shivakumar denies rift, says Siddaramaiah and I stand together
item.description: Deputy Chief Minister and Karnataka Congress President D.K. Shivakumar has clarified that there is no leadership tussle within the Congress-led government between him and Chief Minister Siddaramaiah.

item.title: PM Modi provided excellent guidance to NDA MPs at Parliamentary meet: Kiren Rijiju
item.description: Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju on Tuesday said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi guided NDA leaders on the upcoming state elections and advised them to continue working at the grassroots level to maintain the coalition’s winning momentum.
